title: Strategies from UW-Madison for rescuing biomedical research in the US
abstract: 10.7554/eLife.09305.001 A cross-campus, cross-career stage and cross-disciplinary series of discussions at a large public university has produced a series of recommendations for addressing the problems confronting the biomedical research community in the US. DOI: http://dx.doi.org/10.7554/eLife.09305.001
